The game's database doesn't list which Levemete issues which Levequests and multiple old NPCs also rotate their Levequests when you complete one.

If you'd like to help us, please install the Tracky plugin and enable uploads in its settings.

- Sort = Just sorts your Gear in your Armoury by Item Level descending.
- Split = Basically like Sort, but moving Non-Gearset Gear to the end Slots of each Category.
- Clear = Pulls out your Non-Gearset Gear out of your Armoury to your Inventory.

Allows to clear out one category by another (default) or just taking the highest Item Level of Non-Gearset Gear one after another across the Categories to your Inventory.


Define a limit of free Inventory Space to keep, if you have way too much old gear stuff in your Armoury.


Define, which Categories should be handled, and which not.


Visual feedback for the sorting. Never guess anymore, how unsorted and chaotic your Armoury maybe looks like. TCO will take care of it.


Commands:


- /tco
- /tco settings
- /tco sort
- /tco split
- /tco clear
